messages.author: 080dc3c4433bf8cd
messages.subject: methylkit query
parts:
Hi

While running read.bismark as part of methylKit, the instruction im am giving is-

my.methRaw=read.bismark("/media/data1/sam_files/R6D.sorted.sam",sample.id="sampleR6D",assembly="hg38",read.context="CpG",save.folder=getwd())



And the error I am getting at the end is-
Error in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  :
  scan() expected 'a real', got 'MT.92'
In addition: Warning message:
In dir.create(save.folder, showWarnings = TRUE, recursive = TRUE,  :
  '/media/data1/sam_files' already exists

Although I am also getting a file called SampleR6D_CpG.txt, I am not sure what should I do with the error.


Any help will be appreciated.


Regards,

Roshni

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methylkit query

Best

messages.author: ab8277113f65c05e
messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] methylkit query
parts:
the problem is that R think it is reading number on one column then gets a character or string. The solution I suggest fixes that problem.

There is nothing in read.bismark() that could circumvent this problem, as far as I know.

Best,
Altuna
